Source.reason: Discovery prose, presentation labels, ownership routing, documentation, provenance, and search tags do not change the Source consumer contract.
Source.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion prevents internal paths, author identities, organizational labels, and potentially sensitive prose from entering external contract bytes.
Source.compatibilityImplications: Changes to these descriptive fields do not require a contract version change.

Source.reason: Connector binding and physical location are deployment inputs rather than public Source guarantees.
Source.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion prevents connection identifiers, catalogs, schemas, relation names, filesystem paths, reader options, and location details from leaking.
Source.compatibilityImplications: Rebinding or relocating a Source does not change its external contract when the projected schema and guarantees are unchanged.

Source.reason: Field descriptions and discovery tags are non-executable annotations.
Source.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion avoids publishing free-form field prose and internal taxonomy labels.
Source.compatibilityImplications: Description and tag edits are contract-neutral; datatype and nullability remain projected.

Model.reason: Resource discovery metadata and AI prompting context do not define returned Model values.
Model.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion prevents free-form instructions, examples, internal paths, identities, and organizational annotations from entering external bytes.
Model.compatibilityImplications: These descriptive changes do not require a contract version change.

Model.reason: Presentation, discovery, and AI annotations do not alter entity, field, grain, or executable quality guarantees.
Model.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion avoids publishing free-form prose and internal classification tags that are not themselves the governed field classification.
Model.compatibilityImplications: Annotation edits are contract-neutral; executable check definitions and field datatypes remain projected.

Model.reason: Quality-check descriptions and tags are descriptive evidence annotations; IDs, types, thresholds, and references remain projected.
Model.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion avoids publishing free-form quality prose and internal taxonomy labels.
Model.compatibilityImplications: Description and tag edits do not change executable quality guarantees.

SemanticModel.reason: Resource discovery metadata and AI prompting context are outside governed semantic query behavior.
SemanticModel.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion prevents free-form instructions, examples, internal paths, identities, and organizational annotations from entering external bytes.
SemanticModel.compatibilityImplications: These descriptive changes do not require a contract version change.

SemanticModel.reason: Display, discovery, visibility, and AI annotations do not change the executable semantic or access contract.
SemanticModel.securityPrivacyImplications: Exclusion avoids publishing free-form semantic documentation and AI context; authored access grant names and conditions remain included.
SemanticModel.compatibilityImplications: Annotation and presentation visibility changes are contract-neutral; bindings, filters, metrics, formats, units, and access requirements remain projected.
